summary: Phase 1 features tested end-to-end: Clients CRUD + search + export CSV + sales history modal, Business Settings (load/save with logo), Quote PDF (generate -> preview -> Stampa/Salva PDF opens new window with rendered HTML), Storico tab, CSV exports for filaments and clients, and Sidebar nav links Clienti/Preventivi. Backend pytest: 14/14 passed. Frontend Playwright: all interactive flows verified, no console/page errors.

GET /api/clients -> 200, includes created client, no _id leaked
PUT /api/clients/{id} -> 200, persisted (verified via GET)
DELETE /api/clients/{id} -> 200, verified absent from list
PUT /api/clients/{invalid_id} -> 404
DELETE /api/clients/{invalid_id} -> 404
GET /api/clients/{id}/sales -> 200, list
GET /api/business-settings -> 200, returns all 8 expected fields
PUT /api/business-settings -> 200, persisted (verified via GET) including base64 logo
POST /api/quotes/generate-pdf manual client -> 200, html valid, total=46.00, no cost_per_gram/filament_cost/total_cost/net_profit leaked
POST /api/quotes/generate-pdf with client_id -> 200, client name rendered into html
GET /api/quotes -> 200, history list, no _id leaked, quote_number/subtotal present
GET /api/export/filaments -> 200, text/csv, filamenti.csv, Italian headers
GET /api/export/clients -> 200, text/csv, clienti.csv, contains created client
UI: Sidebar nav-clients and nav-quotes both clickable and navigate correctly
UI Clients: add client form, save -> row appears in table, toast 'Cliente creato'
UI Clients: search filter narrows table (1 result for 'TEST_UI')
UI Clients: client-sales-{id} opens storico modal

action_items: (Optional) Consider validating client_id format in POST /api/quotes/generate-pdf — current code calls ObjectId(quote.client_id) without try/except; an invalid id would 500 instead of 400/404.
(Optional) PDF preview shows product+price only as required, but the html footer prints biz_name even when company_name is empty (renders ' - VAT'). Guard the footer with biz_name truthy.
(Optional code quality) server.py is now ~2573 lines; phase 1 endpoints (clients/business-settings/quotes/exports) would fit well in a routers/billing.py module for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/clients & /api/quotes correctly strip MongoDB _id from responses — good.

Quote PDF generation correctly excludes internal cost fields (cost_per_gram, filament_cost, total_cost, net_profit) — verified by string search on generated HTML. Matches the product requirement 'preventivo deve contenere solo prodotto e prezzo finito (non costo reale)'.

BusinessSettings logo_base64 stored as full data URL (data:image/png;base64,...) and re-injected into the in the PDF html — this works but base64 logos can be large; consider 500KB cap or storing as a separate file/asset later.
CSV exports use BOM (utf-8-sig) so Excel opens Italian accents correctly — good.
PUT /api/business-settings is upsert: true, so first save creates document for the user — correct behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified, no page/console errors)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_UI_* and TEST_* clients deleted via fixture / browser cleanup. A handful of generated quotes (PRV-*) remain in db.quotes since there is no DELETE /api/quotes endpoint — non-blocking, they show up only in the Storico tab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 (Gestione Clienti + Preventivi PDF + Business Settings + CSV exports) is fully working end-to-end. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_clients_quotes_export.py covers backend; the frontend has rich data-testids: clients-page, add-client-btn, search-clients, client-row-{id}, client-sales-{id}, edit-client-{id}, delete-client-{id}, export-clients-btn; quotes-page, tab-create/tab-business/tab-history, quote-client-select/quote-client-name, item-desc-{i}/item-qty-{i}/item-price-{i}, add-quote-item, quote-notes, quote-validity, generate-quote-btn, print-quote-btn, biz-name/biz-vat/biz-address/biz-zip/biz-city/biz-phone/biz-email, upload-logo-btn, save-biz-btn, quote-{id}. There is no DELETE /api/quotes endpoint yet — consider adding before next iteration if Storico cleanup is required.
